definition: Published measured performance improvements. Physical-phone stable-50 and whole-game minimum-55 acceptance remain unresolved.

performanceAcceptance.reason: Dense cancellation draws mostly transparent sprite padding and updates thousands of pooled/overflow animation objects. Crop only certified transparent padding, avoid unnecessary 2D depth attachments, cache unchanged rotation/interpolator work, preallocate the animation slab and reuse overflow allocations. Exact game state is retained. Real desktop stress still has slow intervals; no physical Android measurement supports claiming complete resolution.

pixels.scope: Same hardware WebGL backend and 1280x960. User replay stages 1-6; Extra uses explicit protected fixed input. Every captured game/visual RNG and exposed world state must match. Transparent-padding geometry changes may alter interpolated channels slightly; this is not an exact-pixel pass. Color envelope: max 4/255 and mean .02/255. No physical-phone performance assertion.

controlledRefresh.scope: Real C++ BrowserRuntime RAF loop with controlled browser timestamps; 1280x960; diagnostic, not a phone benchmark.

checks.scope: Exact exposed replay state, both RNG streams, original component checks, depth semantics and protected Extra progression. Cropped transparent sprite padding has measured bounded interpolation differences, not exact-pixel equivalence. Real RAF stress retains all low-frame windows. No physical phone was measured.
